question:
Which of the following letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? 

KS, MU, OW, QY, SA, UC,?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cab77f914b130b5738ef49f8fe71a1e36478284f873af8cf01f813964549489.png] 

Hence, "WE" is the correct answer.
